interpretation: A strict mask defined by (Polar flux<1) AND (OVATION>0) predicts preservation of low-flux cells where OVATION=0. Both saved figures change every such cell beyond tolerance, contradicting that strict gate. A flux-threshold-only mask is consistent with the figures, but output comparisons alone cannot certify checkpoint provenance or scientific observation support.
limitations: Flux below 1.0 is an intensity threshold, not proof that the sensor lacked coverage.
Every remapped Polar input cell has a finite numerical value, which may include fill or interpolated values.
Real-event full-field truth is unavailable, hence accuracy in unobserved areas is not established.
Comparison of time stamps and equal array lengths alone does not prove OVATION maps are calibrated or generated with identical driver records.
